perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: September 14 USAF proximity-sensor production award remains a current production-demand signal with explicit capacity expansion language.
September 3 completion of the first 35 Viper Shield systems and ramp toward 233 systems on order remains a materially different production-conversion datapoint.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Awards and systems on order improve demand visibility; completed initial Viper Shield production is stronger execution evidence than award value alone.
Remaining test is full-rate production, delivery cadence, margins and working-capital/capex conversion across ramps.

lineage.searchStrategy: cumulative evidence reuse; production conversion emphasized
